title: Berberine-associated lipid-inflammatory regulation in atherosclerosis: an integrative transcriptomic, single-cell, and in vivo study.
authors: Yao, Diwei; Wang, Xianqin; Li, Yihang; Wang, Yiping; Mao, Xue; Wang, Yu-E; Qi, Yu; Qiu, Yanning; Chen, Jiale; Shu, Lian
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合转录组、单细胞和动物实验探讨小檗碱在动脉粥样硬化中的脂质-炎症调控，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是疾病表型与药物机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: Atherosclerotic plaques combine disturbed lipid metabolism with myeloid inflammation, yet the human plaque context of berberine (BBR)-related targets remains poorly defined. Paired GSE43292 samples were used to characterize plaque-associated changes, GSE100927 to test reproducibility, and GSE159677 to resolve their cellular distribution. Network pharmacology prioritized BBR-atherosclerosis candidates, with molecular docking and 100-ns molecular dynamics used for structural evaluation. High-fat diet-fed ApoE(-/-) mice received BBR or nanoliposomal BBR (BNL), with atorvastatin as a comparator. In GSE43292, inflammatory response, TNFA signaling via NF-kappaB, cholesterol homeostasis, and fatty acid metabolism were enriched in plaques. GSE100927 reproduced inflammatory response at the pathway level; ABCA1, CD36, IL1B, and TNF showed concordant expression changes. ABCA1, CD36, and IL1B were detected mainly in monocyte/macrophage and other myeloid populations. Inflammatory macrophages showed larger disease-control differences in inflammatory response and TNFA/NF-kappaB module scores. Among 70 overlapping BBR-atherosclerosis targets, PPARG was retained for further evaluation. The predicted BBR-PPARgamma pose remained relatively stable during simulation. In mice, BBR and BNL lowered serum total cholesterol and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, reduced hepatic IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha, and attenuated liver lipid deposition. Hepatic PPARgamma increased significantly only in the BNL group. These findings delineate the myeloid cellular context of lipid- and inflammation-related signals in human plaques and show that BBR and BNL improve selected lipid and hepatic inflammatory measures in ApoE(-/-) mice. PPARG remains a candidate for functional investigation.
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化斑块将脂质代谢紊乱与髓系炎症相结合，然而小檗碱（BBR）相关靶点在人斑块中的背景仍不明确。使用配对的GSE43292样本表征斑块相关变化，GSE100927用于检验可重复性，GSE159677用于解析其细胞分布。网络药理学优先筛选BBR-动脉粥样硬化候选靶点，并通过分子对接和100纳秒分子动力学进行结构评估。高脂饮食喂养的ApoE(-/-)小鼠接受BBR或纳米脂质体BBR（BNL）处理，以阿托伐他汀作为对照。在GSE43292中，炎症反应、经NF-kappaB的TNFA信号、胆固醇稳态和脂肪酸代谢在斑块中富集。GSE100927在通路水平上重现了炎症反应；ABCA1、CD36、IL1B和TNF显示出一致的表达变化。ABCA1、CD36和IL1B主要在单核细胞/巨噬细胞及其他髓系群体中检测到。炎症性巨噬细胞在炎症反应和TNFA/NF-kappaB模块评分中显示出更大的疾病-对照差异。在70个重叠的BBR-动脉粥样硬化靶点中，PPARG被保留用于进一步评估。预测的BBR-PPARgamma结合构象在模拟过程中保持相对稳定。在小鼠中，BBR和BNL降低了血清总胆固醇和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇，减少了肝脏IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha，并减轻了肝脏脂质沉积。仅在BNL组中，肝脏PPARgamma显著增加。这些发现描绘了人斑块中脂质和炎症相关信号的髓系细胞背景，并表明BBR和BNL改善了ApoE(-/-)小鼠中选定的脂质和肝脏炎症指标。PPARG仍是功能研究的候选靶点。
